confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and local meal anchors rest on general knowledge of Kaohsiung price levels and are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because rates vary with events, weekday versus weekend, and listing source. Cocktail and wine are bounded using the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weak, so they are the least certain drink anchors. Taiwan hotel quotes often include taxes and service charges, which the accommodation anchors assume.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a mid-sized Taiwanese port city priced below Taipei and broadly in line with Taichung and Tainan. Drinks and restaurant prices follow typical Taiwanese urban levels; accommodation follows the Formosa Boulevard and Sanduo business and tourist areas, which are typical visitor areas.
